layout.body:
Subject: Workshop registration
Dear Ms. Thompson,
This is to confirm your registration for the online coding workshop on November 3. We recommend that you check your video and audio settings before joining the class. Login details will be sent to this email address on November 2.
Regards,
Alex Kim

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.A: To confirm registration for a workshop
options.B: To cancel registration for a workshop
options.C: To request payment for a workshop
options.D: To provide technical support for a workshop

questions.analysis: What is the main purpose of the email? 原文依据：This is to confirm your registration for the online coding workshop on November 3. 此邮件用于确认您已注册 11 月 3 日的在线编程研讨会。 (A) 确认研讨会的注册 → 正确 (B) 取消研讨会的注册 → 错误 (C) 要求支付研讨会费用 → 错误 (D) 为研讨会提供技术支持 → 错误

questions.stem: What information should Ms. Thompson look for in her email?
questions.analysis: What information should Ms. Thompson look for in her email? 原文依据：Login details will be sent to this email address on November 2.登录信息将于 11 月 2 日发送至此邮箱。 (A) 研讨会日程表 → 错误 (B) 付款收据 → 错误 (C) 登录信息 → 正确 (D) 设备要求 → 错误
